sourceNotes.rawContent:
- Showcase your style with our chic, designer-inspired necklace. This piece features a beautifully detailed coin pendant and a delicate initial charm, combining classic and personalized elements. Crafted from durable anti-tarnish stainless steel and plated in 18K gold, it's a versatile and fashionable accessory for any look.
-
- Premium Quality | Anti-Tarnish
- Base Material: Stainless Steel
- Plating: 18K Gold-Plated
- Shape: Coin and Initial
- Size: One-size & Adjustable
- Net Quantity: 1
- Designed to complement both casual and formal outfits effortlessly
- Care Tips:
-
- Wipe with a soft cloth after every use
- Avoid contact with harsh chemicals, sprays, and perfumes
- Store in a flat box to prevent scratches
- Do not soak in water
- Keywords: designer inspired necklace, coin pendant, initial necklace, gold jewelry, anti-tarnish, stainless steel, luxury jewelry, personalized necklace, fashion accessory, online boutique
